title: Yummy Velvety Indian Chicken Korma
description: A spicy and creamy Indian-inspired dish perfect for a monsoon evening, made dairy-free friendly by using non-dairy milk and yogurt. This recipe adds a unique twist with the addition of Christmas pudding, which helps to balance the spiciness of the dish.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk (such as almond or soy milk)

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it's lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the garam masala, cumin, smoked paprika, and salt. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Pour in the non-dairy milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it cook for 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the soaked Christmas pudding (if using) and cook for another 2 minutes.
Serve the korma hot, garnished with fresh cilantro leaves (if desired).
